title: GTA 6 Original Score Soundtrack Announced, Vinyl Pre-Orders Go Live
description: Rockstar Games announces the GTA 6 Original Score composed by Justice, with vinyl and CD pre-orders live ahead of the December 2026 release.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Original Score Announced by Rockstar Games
socialHook: Rockstar Games announces GTA 6 original score with vinyl pre-orders live.

sections.heading: Soundtrack Announcement
paragraphs: Rockstar Games has officially announced the GTA 6 Original Score, composed by the French electronic duo Justice. The physical release will include a 30-track vinyl set spanning 3 hours, while digital streaming offers an extended 50-track list. Pre-orders go live immediately, with multiple vinyl variants exclusive to retailers like Rough Trade. This score differs from the previously announced GTA VI: The Album, focusing on adaptive background music for gameplay rather than radio anthems.

sections.heading: Release Details & Formats
paragraphs: The complete GTA VI: Original Score will release on December 11th, 2026, available in both vinyl and CD formats with gatefold covers featuring game artwork. Bonus content is included per product listings, and the vinyl comes in black standard and crystal-clear editions through select stores. Digital pre-orders and physical bundles support RockstarINTEL through commission links. Fans can expect the adaptive score to dynamically track player actions across Vice City and Leonida during Jason and Lucia’s story.
